notes.title: The Beginner's Guide Update Released
notes.content:
An update to The Beginner's Guide has been released. The major changes include:

All platforms
[list]
[*]Resolved an issue where pressing 9 could cause the game to crash.
[/list]

Windows
[list]
[*]Resolved various issues that could cause the game to fail to start up.
[*]Resolved an issue in which the game would crash at seemingly random points.
[/list]

Mac
[list]
[*]Resolved various issues that could cause the game to fail to start up.
[/list]

Linux
[list]
[*]Resolved an issue that caused some UI icons to be displayed as letters, instead of icons.
[/list]
